title: AI Agent Threat Matrix evidence sources
description: Shape of evidence-sources.json: the pages of related projects that evidence entries in matrix.json cite, each pinned at the commit that wrote it. scripts/pin_evidence_sources.py writes the file from a git clone; scripts/validate_matrix.py checks it against this schema and the rules the schema cannot express (see the x-semantic notes), and resolves a lab-reproduction evidence entry against it.

dvaa.description: The DVAA pages that lab-reproduction entries cite, read from a git clone of the repository at one commit: the scenario pages that name a technique, and the challenges and scenario pages a technique's dvaaValidation names.

head.description: The commit the clone was read at.

read.description: The date the clone was read.
read.x-semantic: no later than the day the validator runs

challenges.description: Absent when no technique's dvaaValidation names a challenge the file defines at head.

scenarios.description: Absent when no technique's dvaaValidation names a scenario whose page head holds.
scenarios.x-semantic: at least one entry; no path twice; each the page of a scenario a technique's dvaaValidation names

challengeFile.description: DVAA's challenge definitions, pinned as a page is, with each challenge a technique's dvaaValidation names. The permalink of a challenge, <repository>/blob/<commit>/<path>#L<line>, is the reference of the lab-reproduction entries it backs.

commit.description: The last commit at or before head that changed the file.

committed.description: The date of that commit as its committer recorded it, and the date of the entries the challenges back.

blob.description: The git blob id of the file at that commit.

named.x-semantic: at least one entry; no id twice; each id named by a technique's dvaaValidation

challenge.description: One challenge of the file's CHALLENGES object, as the file defines it: the line of its key, its id and its name.

scenarioPage.description: The page of a scenario a technique's dvaaValidation names, pinned as a page is. Its permalink, <repository>/blob/<commit>/<path>, is the reference of the lab-reproduction entries it backs.

commit.description: The last commit at or before head that changed the page.

committed.description: The date of that commit as its committer recorded it, and the date of the entries the page backs.

blob.description: The git blob id of the page at that commit.

page.description: One scenario page and the techniques it names. Its permalink, <repository>/blob/<commit>/<path>, is the reference of the lab-reproduction entries it backs.

commit.description: The last commit at or before head that changed the page.

committed.description: The date of that commit as its committer recorded it, and the date of the entries the page backs.

blob.description: The git blob id of the page at that commit.

name.description: One name of a technique on the page, in bold as **T-NNNN (Label):**, the form DVAA gives the steps of an attack chain, as the page writes it.
